text:
maria: Heads-up — seeing ~120 SLA misses in EMEA between 07:00-09:30 UTC. Looks tied to leads stuck in enrichment window and owner mapping for DST regions. Anyone else?

sam_revops: yep saw spike. Most are HubSpot->SF handoffs where owner is null after enrichment TTL expires.

jordan_pm: Do we have a quick mitigation? Can we reassign to overflow pool after X mins?

leo_eng: We can toggle a temporary `enrichment_hold` flag that holds the lead in intake but marks it for forced RR after 6m. Minimal config change. Also can bias RR to same-timezone owners to reduce cross-dst flips.

alan_salesops: Confirmed — a stale webhook was overwriting timezone on a subset of contacts. I'll push a HubSpot mapping patch to stop nulling timezone. Sample patch:```
# HubSpot mapping pseudo
if hs_contact.get('timezone') is None:
  lead.timezone = hs_contact.get('timezone_guess')
else:
  lead.timezone = hs_contact.get('timezone')
```

maria: Nice. Leo — can you sketch the quick RR tweak?

leo_eng: RR tweak (pseudo):```
# prefer same-tz owners, then least-recently-assigned
candidates.sort(key=lambda c: (0 if c.tz == lead.tz else 1, c.last_assigned_ts))
```
We'd add a feature flag so we can flip back if we see regressions.

sam_revops: Can we make this a deployless toggle? Also want to add a short-term rule: if enrichment_hold > 6m -> auto-assign to overflow pool.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: PR created -> #4587 (enrichment_hold + rr-tz-bias). CI: ✅. Staging deploy scheduled.

leo_eng: Flipped enrichment_hold in staging and enabled tz-bias flag. Running smoke tests against nightshift traffic. No errors so far.

sam_revops: I'll update the handoff playbook and ping SDR leads with the temporary behavior + how to claim overflow leads. Also adding metric `enrichment_hold_resolves` to Grafana.

jordan_pm: Action owners: leo -> prod flip after 10m smoke; sam -> playbook + comms; alan -> HubSpot mapping PR; maria -> monitor SLA dashboard and escalate if no improvement. Check back in 30m.

maria: :thumbsup: thanks team. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/reports/lead-hand-off-sla — watching the EMEA line.

leo_eng: prod flip complete at +12m. No regressions in 8m. Early signal: SLA misses down ~70% for the interval.

sam_revops: Comms sent to SDRs + short walkthrough in #marketing.

alan_salesops: HubSpot mapping PR merged and deployed to staging; will push to prod after confirmation window.

jordan_pm: Nice work. We'll leave tz-bias on for 48h and then review metrics + call with SDR leads tomorrow.

maria: Closing the incident thread once we confirm 24h stable. Thank you all.
